proxy.title: API keys
proxy.lede: Pages of the site call third-party APIs (OpenAI, a CRM, a Telegram bot) through the site's own address. The key is stored encrypted on the server and never reaches the page's code.
proxy.warn.title: Any visitor of the site can call an endpoint.
proxy.warn.text: Limit paths and methods to what the page needs, and use a key with minimal rights and a spending limit at the API provider.
proxy.key.hint: The key is not shown after saving. Do not send it to an assistant in a chat.
proxy.form.keyhint: Changing the address, the hosts or how the key is sent removes the stored key: it has to be pasted again.
proxy.field.name: Name
proxy.field.name.hint: Latin letters, digits and hyphens, e.g. openai. The page calls /_dropsite/proxy/<name>/…
proxy.field.url.hint: https only. For Telegram: https://api.telegram.org/bot{secret}. Do not put the key into the address.
proxy.field.authname.hint: For a custom header, e.g. X-Api-Key, or for a query parameter, e.g. api_key.
proxy.field.paths.hint: One prefix per line, e.g. /chat/completions. Empty means any path.
proxy.field.hosts.hint: Exact host names the API may redirect to. The host of the base address is always allowed.
proxy.howto: How to call it from a page
proxy.howto.text: The page calls a relative address on its own site, without the key. The server adds the key and forwards the request.
proxy.created: Endpoint {name} created. Paste the API key in its card.
proxy.saved.nokey: Endpoint {name} saved. It has no key: paste it in the endpoint's card.
err.proxy_invalid: The endpoint was not saved: check the settings.
err.proxy_limit_reached: The site already has {limit} endpoints. Delete one you do not need.
err.proxy_secret_ui_only: The key is entered only on the API keys screen.
err.proxy_secret_invalid: The key must be one line of at most 4096 characters.
err.proxy_origin: The request came from another site.
err.proxy_method: This method is not allowed for the endpoint.
err.proxy_path: This path is not allowed for the endpoint.
err.proxy_secret_missing: The endpoint has no key yet.
err.proxy_timeout: The API service did not answer in time.
